description: Source code for the Cluster-related methods of the PlatformService in Mattermost, handling cluster communication, leader election, WebSocket events, and plugin key-value storage.

classes.name: ClusterDiscoveryService
classes.description: Service for discovering cluster nodes and managing cluster state.

methods.name: Cluster
methods.description: Returns the cluster interface for cluster communication.

methods.name: NewClusterDiscoveryService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ClusterDiscoveryService.

methods.name: IsLeader
methods.description: Determines if the current node is the cluster leader.

methods.name: PublishPluginClusterEvent
methods.description: Publishes a plugin cluster event to other cluster nodes.

methods.name: PublishWebSocketEvent
methods.description: Publishes a WebSocket event to clients and cluster.

methods.name: SetPluginKeyWithOptions
methods.description: Sets a plugin key-value pair with options, handling hashed keys.

methods.name: KVGet
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin key-value, checking both plain and hashed keys.

methods.name: KVDelete
methods.description: Deletes a plugin key-value pair, both plain and hashed.

methods.name: AddClusterLeaderChangedListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for cluster leader change events.

methods.name: RemoveClusterLeaderChangedListener
methods.description: Removes a registered cluster leader change callback.

methods.name: InvokeClusterLeaderChangedListeners
methods.description: Invokes all registered cluster leader change callbacks.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes a WebSocket event to clients and cluster.

methods.name: PublishSkipClusterSend
methods.description: Broadcasts a WebSocket event to clients without cluster messaging.
